notes.title: Version 1.9.9
notes.notes:
I was hoping to have version 2.0 finished and realeased by June 15. Due to covid and many family deaths over this past year I've been very busy with memorial services and being a 24/7 caregiver to my sister until her workers can come back to the house and care for her. So I have been using what little time I have to make subtle changes to all classes and what spells are available at certain levels. I'm making it to where the job points are going to play a bigger role when playing the beginning realms. I also felt that the damage physics was off balance and noticed that there were no differences between physical attacks and magical attacks. So I've recalculated all the abilities and also made luck become a factor as to how much damage one does to the enemy and luck is used in the calculations on how well you defend against that attack. I've also nerfed all the buffs so the game doesn't feel too easy half way through the realms. I'm still in the final testing phase and so far I'm happy with the results. 

I'm hoping to get back on track in August and I'll be putting all the work I can into finishing the third realm and hoping to add the fourth realm by June 15, 2022. I'm going to be doing double the work these next 12 months to get me back to my original schedule.

notes.title: Version 1.9.5
notes.notes:
Today marks my 1 year anniversary since I posted my game in the store. There has been a lot of content updated for me to utilize this past year to help improve my game and design most of it the way I originally designed it thanks to the new plugins that were developed over the past few months. There was a lot of re-coding I had to do and half the game has been redesigned for these updates.

There are a lot of changes I made into this new patch and they will be listed below. One of the biggest changes I made is removing all weapons and armor from the drop item cache in my monster list. I noticed that the plugin that allows the diversity of these items was causing the save and load game to take up to 3 to 5 minutes half way through the 1st realm. So by removing them from the drop list I've shortened the save and load time to an average of 30 seconds to a minute. Through a lot of extensive testing this really doesn't change the dynamics of the gameplay all that much and it also saves time going through all the items you've collected. 

I just want to thank everyone for the feedback and support and look forward to hearing more suggestions and thoughts on what you're hoping to see in the future and how to better improve the game. 

Below you will find the patch notes for this update:

It is recommended to start a new game when downloading new patch
+ New Game can crash when you reach that point in the game

Version 1.9.5

 Adding minimaps to game
 More enenmies can now be summoned in the middle of battle (Epic Battle will be released on number of summons and get an item cache after winning battle)
 Autosave feature added for dungeons after completing current floor (can be switched off by talking to barmaid in pub)
 More colors to show item rarity (Each tier has a color ranging 1-5. Weapons and Armor are sorted accordingly)
 Abilities now have Skill Mastery Levels for using the same ability over and over again (With each level the ability will become stronger, cost less MP, and reduces the Cooldown on that ability)
 All dungeons are completley remapped 
 Level cap changes as difficulty progresses (thanks to Mr. Trivel)
 Weapons and Armor now have level requirements based on rarity
 Difficulty on enemies has been raised
 Updated Damage Popup and is abbriviated by 1 million dmg (thanks to Azel)
 Realm 2 is temporarily locked til all updates on maps are completed

notes.title: Version 1.4.0 Early Release
notes.notes:
The beginning battles turned out to be more difficult than anticipated and I've received feedback that players are finding it very difficult to progress when they first start out. Instead of working backwards and fixing this I've added the fix to 1.4.0 and I'm uploading the patch today. The patch will be available and will auto update by the end of the day.

notes.title: Update For Future Patch
notes.notes:
Due to physical health complications my doctor had me on bed rest for the last week. Since I couldn't go to work this allowed me to put in a lot of extra hours to start building the 2nd realm. The over world appearance doesn't change. There will be more dungeon floors added to the planetary dungeons. (If you start a new game when this version drops, the new dungeon floors are added to the randomizer and will populate in the first realm as well.) All the orb trials will have their own rooms to navigate through to claim the orbs. There is a 5th party member that will join as a class Red Mage. Red Mages have all the abilities of the white and black mages but are denied all the massive kill all spells. All the dungeons difficulty are turned up by times 2. The damage cap has been divided by 10. Realm 2 is up to the Jupiter Dungeon built and completed. I didn't create seperate builds only because I was able to move forward very quickly.

1.4.0 is set to be completed and uploaded by 10/15/2018. Right now the game is set on an infinite +NewGame loop after you complete the first realm. When the patch goes live, the loop will be removed and after you reach the last dungeon available, the game will restart to the very beginning. I'll be releasing the full patch notes for 1.4.0 10/1/2018 to list all the changes and additions made to the game. There's still a lot of testing to do and I need to make sure the formulas used for damage won't do too much or too little.
